transcript: Coach. Hello, thanks for contacting FitTrack Wellness. This is Mira speaking. How can I help you today? Client. Hi Mira. I'm not ready to start any program immediately. I just want to understand what kind of plans you offer and roughly how much they cost. Coach, that's perfectly fine. Are you looking for general fitness, weight loss, or something more specific? Client. Mainly weight loss and improving stamina. I get tired very easily these days. Coach, understood. Have you followed any fitness program earlier? Client. Yes, about two years ago. I paid quite a bit, but I couldn't stay consistent so I don't want to overspend this time. Coach, that's completely understandable. How many days a week do you think you can realistically work out? Client. Around four days, but sessions shouldn't be too long, maybe 40 minutes max. Coach, that works well. Do you prefer home workouts or gym workouts? Client. Home workouts only. Gym memberships add extra cost and pressure. Coach, got it. Let me give you a rough idea of pricing. Then we can see what fits. Our basic home workout plan starts at 3000 per month, which includes workout schedules and weekly check-ins. Client. Okay. What about diet guidance? That's where I usually struggle. Coach, for workouts plus personalized diet guidance, the plan is 5,500 per month. This includes calorie tracking and biweekly progress reviews. Client. That's slightly higher than I expected. Are there longer term plans that cost less per month? Coach, yes. If you take a three-month plan, it comes to 14,000 total, which brings it down to around 4,700 per month. Client. That sounds more reasonable. What about support? I tend to lose motivation midway. Coach, for that we have a premium coaching plan at 18,000 for three months. It includes weekly video calls, habit coaching, and daily WhatsApp support. Client. That sounds helpful, but I'm not sure I want to commit that much money up front. Coach, that's fair. Many people start with the one-month plan and upgrade later once they're comfortable. Client. If I start with one month at 5,500 and feel it's working, can I switch to the three-month plan without losing money? Coach, absolutely. We adjust the amount you won't be paying extra for switching. Client. That's good to know. Also, if my work gets hectic, can sessions be adjusted? Coach, yes. All home plans are flexible. Even if you miss a week, we rebalance the schedule. Client. All right. I'm not deciding today, but this gives me clarity. Coach, no worries at all. Would you like me to follow up in a few days? Client. Yes. Maybe Friday evening. Please remind me I tend to procrastinate. Coach, note it. I'll schedule a follow-up for Friday evening and we can take it from there. Client, thanks Mira. This was helpful. Coach, you're welcome. Take care and speak to you soon.
